summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held October 29, 2026 in Toronto, plus the related Report on Voting. All five director nominees, including CEO Richard Lu, were elected with roughly 99% support; shareholders also approved Deloitte LLP as auditors and passed a special resolution authorizing a share consolidation at a ratio to be fixed by the directors. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is a routine meeting-result filing, not a special situation.
